statements.label: def:norm
statements.body: A \emph{norm} on $\mathbb{R}^n$ is a function $\left\lVert \cdot \right\rVert : \mathbb{R}^n \to \mathbb{R}$ that is positive-definite, homogeneous, and satisfies the triangle inequality.

statements.label: thm:main
statements.body: For every $x \in \mathbb{R}^n$ we have $\left\lVert x \right\rVert \geq 0$, with equality iff $x = 0$.
A second numbered theorem, appearing in the second section.
This unnumbered remark should carry no reference number.
